# find block

# cells changed: all become 2?

# changed cells not in full rows/cols?

P='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0d4-u1-ceiling/frozen/held-out-4/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(P,exist_ok=True)
prog='''def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==2]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in cells); r1=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    c0=min(j for _,j in cells); c1=max(j for _,j in cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    MARK=lambda v: v not in (0,2)
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        if not any(MARK(g[i][j]) for j in range(0,c0)):
            for j in range(0,c0): out[i][j]=2
        if not any(MARK(g[i][j]) for j in range(c1+1,w)):
            for j in range(c1+1,w): out[i][j]=2
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        if not any(MARK(g[i][j]) for i in range(0,r0)):
            for i in range(0,r0): out[i][j]=2
        if not any(MARK(g[i][j]) for i in range(r1+1,h)):
            for i in range(r1+1,h): out[i][j]=2
    return out
'''
